args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, the service failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. Action taken: rolled back checkout-api in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. (v2.3.1-rc was only verified healthy in staging, so it was not used.) After the rollback, all regions are on v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate.
- **Version I picked:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I didn't use v2.3.1-rc because it was only healthy in staging.
- **Result:** All three regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is a SEV2 for checkout-api. It describes the failure, the rollback and the result, and says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging).
